Shipped forecast-window alerting (AlertWindow: overnight + next 6/12/24h) with pure forecast evaluation path, worker wiring, persistence, and builder UI. Temperature/wind windows cover overnight-low/frost/heat/wind-ahead; precip-probability rules split to just-my-weather-x5p. Verified on device.

Shipped density spectrum: Density enum (Spacious/Comfortable/Compact) persisted in ViewConfig, mapped to hero size + row/section spacing + timestamp visibility via DensitySpec; Customize chip row drives it, HomeScreen reads it. Default unchanged. Verified live on device.

Shipped theming: ThemeConfig (mood system/light/dark, 6 accents, sans/serif/mono) persisted via DataStore alongside ViewConfig; Theme.kt maps it to colorScheme/accent/typeface in one place; ThemeViewModel wraps the app so changes re-theme live; Customize 'Look' section drives it. Defaults match shipped look. Verified on device.

Shipped precip-chance forecast alerts. ForecastPoint+probabilityOfPrecipitation parsed; new sealed AlertSubject (WeatherField | PrecipChance) replaces AlertRule.field — precip is forecast-only (kept out of the view catalog), rides the max-over-window path. Codec back-compat via legacy 'field' key. Builder offers rain only under forecast windows. Verified on device.

Shipped both deferred NWS-port bits. (1) Point cache persisted across process death via a PointCache seam (InMemory default + DataStorePointCache durable, PointCacheCodec); WeatherRepository delegates to it under the resolve mutex; AppContainer wires the durable one. (2) getHourlyForecast now covered for precip-probability + Celsius conversion. Verified on device: force-stop+relaunch persists point_cache and still renders weather.

Periodic alert worker now scheduled only when an enabled rule exists. AlertWorker.sync()/cancel(); AlertsViewModel re-syncs on every edit (onRulesChanged); onCreate schedules only if rules are live. Verified via WorkManager diagnostics: personal-alerts CANCELLED with no rules, ENQUEUED after adding one.

Shipped quiet hours (v1 of tone/frequency): global AlertSettings (quietHoursEnabled + window, isQuietAt wraps midnight) persisted via DataStore; AlertNotifier gained a low-importance silent channel; the worker delivers on it during quiet hours so overnight alerts arrive hushed, not dropped. Alerts screen toggle. Remaining knobs (custom window, per-rule tone/snooze, cadence) split to just-my-weather-pcj/-ken. Verified on device.

Open-source readiness shipped: LICENSE (Apache-2.0, © Raylytics) + NOTICE; README status refreshed to shipped state + License section; CONTRIBUTING.md (gate, conventions, field-keyword trap, licensing); docs/architecture.md (package map + data flow) and docs/extending.md (recipes for adding a data point / alert subject / window / theme accent / density / persisted setting). Screenshots + GitHub templates split to just-my-weather-tfe.

Added mipmap-anydpi/ic_launcher.xml (layer-list of background colour + sun foreground vector) as the pre-26 launcher icon fallback. aapt2 confirms mipmap/ic_launcher packages both anydpi-v21 (fallback for API 24-25) and anydpi-v26 (adaptive icon, 26+). Build + ktlint green.

Added testTagsAsResourceId at the root (MainActivity) + testTags on the customize Switch/reorder controls (toggle_<key>, moveUp/moveDown_<key>), and .maestro/01-customize.yaml toggling Wind on and asserting it appears on home. Verified: 01-customize and 00-smoke both pass on Pixel_7_API_34.

Added docs/screenshots/{glance,customize,alerts}.png (captured at calm defaults) embedded in an 'A look' README section, plus .github/ issue templates (bug + feature) and a PR template (gate checklist + Apache-2.0 note).

Testing & tooling complete: 77 JUnit5/Mockito unit tests, ktlint gate, pre-commit hook (scripts/hooks), Maestro flows (00-smoke + 01-customize), and now CI — .github/workflows/ci.yml runs test+ktlint+assemble on push/PR. Verified the CI run passes green on GitHub (run 28445338043, 5m52s).
